headlines.title: 商务部等9部门：加强航空保税维修财税、金融政策支持
headlines.summary: 商务部等9部门关于促进航空保税维修高质量发展的意见，其中提到，航空保税维修后的产品，不复运出境转为内销的，在获得相关适航证明后，可以按照国家有关规定办理内销手续。综合保税区内维修后产品内销，以修理后货物的实际报验状态照章征收进口关税、进口环节增值税和消费税；综合保税区外保税维修后产品内销，按保税货物一线进口状态补缴进口关税、进口环节增值税和消费税，照章征收国内环节增值税、消费税。维修企业提供保税维修等对外修理修配服务，可按规定适用出口退（免）税政策。加强财政与保险等金融政策联动，提升出口信保承保积极性和服务质效，支持航空保税维修高质量发展。

headlines.title_en: Nine ministries including MOFCOM: Strengthen fiscal, tax, and financial policy support for aviation bonded maintenance
headlines.summary_en: Opinion of 9 ministries including the Ministry of Commerce on promoting the high-quality development of aviation bonded maintenance: products after aviation bonded maintenance that are not re-exported but sold domestically may, after obtaining relevant airworthiness certificates, go through domestic sales procedures in accordance with national regulations. For products sold domestically after maintenance within a comprehensive bonded zone, import tariffs, import value-added tax and consumption tax shall be levied according to the actual declared status of the repaired goods; for products sold domestically after bonded maintenance outside the comprehensive bonded zone, import tariffs, import value-added tax and consumption tax shall be paid retroactively based on the first-line import status of bonded goods, and domestic value-added tax and consumption tax shall be levied as required. Maintenance enterprises providing bonded maintenance and other external repair services may apply for export tax rebate (exemption) policies as stipulated. Strengthen coordination between fiscal and financial policies such as insurance, enhance enthusiasm and service quality of export credit insurance underwriting, and support the high-quality development of aviation bonded maintenance.

headlines.title_en: Wang Yi meets with US Ambassador to China Brent Christensen
headlines.summary_en: On August 26, Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister Wang Yi met with US Ambassador to China Nicholas Burns in Beijing. Wang Yi said that under the guidance of the two heads of state, both sides are working to build a constructive and strategically stable China-US relationship. Facts have proven that improving and developing China-US relations, coexisting peacefully on the basis of mutual respect, and then achieving win-win cooperation, serves the fundamental interests of both peoples and meets the common expectations of the international community. At the same time, China-US relations still face various risks and challenges. Both sides should implement the important consensus reached by the two heads of state, focus on a positive agenda, properly manage differences, remove interference and overcome obstacles for high-level exchanges between the two countries, and promote the stable, healthy and sustainable development of China-US relations.

headlines.title: 机构：杰克逊霍尔会议料聚焦美联储长期政策方向
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月27日讯，Isio Investment Management首席投资官Ajith Nair表示，杰克逊霍尔研讨会可能不会过多聚焦眼前的政策决定，而是更多关注货币政策的长期方向、央行的政策思路及其对投资者的影响。“尽管市场自然会关注利率，但今年更值得关注的是沃什首次以美联储主席身份亮相杰克逊霍尔，以及这可能透露出他对美联储未来发展的何种愿景。”Nair指出，在沃什领导下，最值得关注的变化之一是，他似乎希望降低市场对美联储预测和政策路径预估的依赖，而此次杰克逊霍尔会议可能进一步强化这一做法。

headlines.title_en: Institution: Jackson Hole meeting expected to focus on Fed's long-term policy direction
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data August 27: Ajith Nair, Chief Investment Officer at Isio Investment Management, said the Jackson Hole symposium may focus less on immediate policy decisions and more on the long-term direction of monetary policy, central bank thinking, and its impact on investors. 'While markets will naturally focus on rates, what is more noteworthy this year is Warsh's debut at Jackson Hole as Fed chair and what it may reveal about his vision for the Fed's future,' Nair noted. Under Warsh, one of the most notable changes is that he appears to want to reduce market reliance on Fed forecasts and policy path estimates, and this Jackson Hole meeting may further reinforce that approach.

headlines.title: 国家统计局：1-7月规模以上高技术制造业利润同比增长50.1%
headlines.summary: 1—7月份，制造业向产业链、价值链中高端转型持续推进，规模以上高技术制造业利润同比增长50.1%，拉动全部规模以上工业企业利润增长9.6个百分点。从行业看，电子及通信设备制造领域中，光纤制造、光缆制造、通信系统设备制造行业利润分别增长468.4%、62.6%、55.0%；医疗仪器设备及仪器仪表制造领域中，导航、测绘、气象及海洋专用仪器制造行业利润增长157.8%，口腔科用设备及器具制造行业利润增长74.5%。

headlines.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics: Profits of large-scale high-tech manufacturing up 50.1% year-on-year in Jan-Jul
headlines.summary_en: From January to July, manufacturing continued its transition toward mid-to-high-end segments of the industrial and value chains. Profits of above-scale high-tech manufacturing rose 50.1% year-on-year, contributing 9.6 percentage points to the profit growth of all above-scale industrial enterprises. By industry, in the electronics and communication equipment manufacturing sector, profits of optical fiber manufacturing, optical cable manufacturing, and communication system equipment manufacturing grew 468.4%, 62.6% and 55.0%, respectively; in the medical instruments and equipment and instrumentation manufacturing sector, profits of navigation, surveying, meteorological and marine special instrument manufacturing grew 157.8%, and dental equipment and appliance manufacturing profits grew 74.5%.

headlines.title: 知情人士回应“A股未盈利企业无法上市”：不封堵只提质
headlines.summary: 近日，有市场传言称，A股未盈利企业IPO申报全面收紧，港股同步受到影响。记者从知情人士处了解到，目前不存在未盈利企业一律无法上市的可能性，无论A股还是港股，都会继续向优质未盈利企业敞开大门，只是对未盈利企业的审核更为严格，要求企业具备更为明确的商业变现路径与业绩改善预期；对于亏损持续未见收窄、短期商业化落地难度较大，且并非细分行业绝对头部的企业，IPO审核尺度将更为严苛。（21世纪经济报道）

headlines.title_en: Insider response to 'unprofitable A-share companies cannot list': Not blocking, just improving quality
headlines.summary_en: Recently, market rumors suggest that IPO filings by unprofitable companies in A-shares have been comprehensively tightened, with Hong Kong stocks also affected. A source familiar with the matter told reporters that there is currently no possibility of a blanket ban on listings by unprofitable companies; both A-shares and Hong Kong stocks will continue to open their doors to high-quality unprofitable companies, but reviews for unprofitable companies have become stricter, requiring clearer commercial monetization paths and expectations for performance improvement. For companies with persistent losses that have not narrowed, greater difficulty in near-term commercialization, and that are not absolute leaders in their sub-industries, IPO review standards will be more stringent. (21st Century Business Herald)

headlines.title: 韩国央行：预计通胀率将在相当长一段时间内持续高于目标水平
headlines.summary: 韩国央行：预计通胀率将在相当长一段时间内持续高于目标水平。 未来通胀走向面临较高不确定性，主要与油价、汇率、内需复苏节奏以及工资上涨扩散程度相关。 将继续实施能将CPI通胀率稳定在目标水平的货币政策。 在出口和投资保持高增长的推动下，预计国内经济将继续维持强劲增长。 消费复苏步伐将逐渐加快。 将评估通胀、国内经济以及金融稳定状况。 需要密切关注居民债务增长情况。 芯片领域的扩张程度、中东局势发展以及贸易环境的变化仍存在不确定性。

headlines.title_en: Bank of Korea: Inflation expected to remain above target for a considerable period
headlines.summary_en: Bank of Korea: Inflation is expected to remain above target for a considerable period. Future inflation path faces high uncertainty, mainly related to oil prices, exchange rates, pace of domestic demand recovery, and spread of wage increases. Will continue monetary policy that stabilizes CPI inflation at target level. Domestic economy is expected to continue strong growth, driven by high growth in exports and investment. Consumption recovery pace will gradually accelerate. Will assess inflation, domestic economy, and financial stability conditions. Need to closely monitor household debt growth. Uncertainty remains over the extent of chip sector expansion, Middle East developments, and changes in trade environment.

headlines.summary: 【华福证券首席经济学家管涛：外部流动性影响A股需“精准拆解”】华福证券首席经济学家、福建研究院院长管涛在接受21世纪经济报道记者采访时表示，去年美联储降息三次，今年以来按兵不动，但市场预期频繁反复，导致金融条件总体宽松但波动显著放大。但外部流动性影响需区分具体驱动源，并置于不同前提下分析，不可简单归因。

headlines.title_en: Huafu Securities Chief Economist Guan Tao: External liquidity impact on A-shares requires 'precise dismantling'
headlines.summary_en: [HuaFu Securities Chief Economist Guan Tao: External Liquidity Impact on A-Shares Requires 'Precise Decomposition'] Guan Tao, chief economist at HuaFu Securities and dean of the Fujian Research Institute, said in an interview with 21st Century Business Herald that the Fed cut rates three times last year and has remained on hold this year, but frequent shifts in market expectations have led to broadly loose financial conditions with significantly amplified volatility. However, the impact of external liquidity needs to be distinguished by specific drivers and analyzed under different premises, and cannot be simply attributed.
